about: 지급명세서(일용직)(E020146) · 원천징수영수증(일용직)(C000733) — 숫자는 그 지급연월의 일용근로 급여대장에서, 지급명세서는 만들 때 담아 둔다. 원본 2026-10-14 QA세무-일용(일당 200,000): 근무기록확정 2 → 전체계산 400,000(공제 0) → [신규] 서식 '1 명 1 건 400,000 0 0 0', 같은 지급연월 두 번째 [저장] '이미 생성된 자료입니다.', 대장을 3일 600,000 으로 다시 계산해도 서식 400,000 → [새로불러오기] 확인 창 뒤 600,000 · 3. 영수증 목록은 대장 그대로 600,000. 2091/10 에 만들고 끝에 지운다.

JSON.parse(t) : null } }; const st = (await j('GET', '/simple-payment-statements?daily=true')).d.filter((s) => s.managerDept === 'QA세무' && s.payYear === 2091).map((s) => s.id); if (st.length) await j('POST', '/simple-payment-statements/delete', st); for (const l of (await j('GET', '/hr/daily-pay-ledgers')).d.filter((l) => l.payMonth === '2091-10')) await j('DELETE', '/hr/daily-pay-ledgers/' + l.id); for (const w of (await j('GET', '/hr/daily-workers')).d.filter((w) => w.name === 'QA세무-일용')) await j('DELETE', '/hr/daily-workers/' + w.id); const w = (await j('POST', '/hr/daily-workers', { name: 'QA세무-일용', hireDate: '2091-10-01', dailyWage: 200000, foreigner: false, employmentInsurance: false, pensionAuto: false, healthAuto: false })).d; const l = (await j('POST', '/hr/daily-pay-ledgers', { payMonth: '2091-10', paidMonth: '2091-10', payDate: '2091-10-31' })).d; await j('PUT', '/hr/daily-pay-ledgers/' + l.id + '/work-confirms', [{ workerId: w.id, days: 2 }]); await j('POST', '/hr/daily-pay-ledgers/' + l.id + '/calculate', {}); const body = { kind: 'DAILY', payYear: 2091, period: 10, reportDate: '2091-10-31', managerDept: 'QA세무', managerName: 'QA세무', managerPhone: '02-000-0000', submitter: 'DIRECT' }; const a = await j('POST', '/simple-payment-statements', body); const dup = await j('POST', '/simple-payment-statements', body); await j('PUT', '/hr/daily-pay-ledgers/' + l.id + '/work-confirms', [{ workerId: w.id, days: 3 }]); await j('POST', '/hr/daily-pay-ledgers/' + l.id + '/calculate', {}); const rc = (await j('GET', '/withholding/daily-receipts?month=2091-10')).d.find((r) => r.employeeName === 'QA세무-일용'); window.__qa = a.s + ' ' + dup.s + ' ' + (dup.d && dup.d.message) + ' ' + (rc && rc.totalPay); return 'setup ' + window.__qa })()
